job_description:
Responsibilities: Preparing ingredients for cooking (cutting, washing, etc.) before cooking Assisting chefs and kitchen staff in their work Keeping the kitchen and work area clean and tidy Washing and organizing utensils and kitchen equipment Maintaining hygiene and food safety during food preparation Assisting in proper storage of necessary kitchen items Completing assigned tasks as per instructions and on time Working as a team in the kitchen and maintaining cooperation

Requirements: Interest in learning and sense of responsibility towards work Concept of kitchen hygiene and cleanliness Ability to work for long hours Mentality to follow teamwork and guidance At least 1 year of experience is preferable Opportunity for training if suitable candidate Mentality to work in both shifts Salary and Benefits Monthly Salary: 8,000-10,000 Taka Food Allowance: 2,500 Taka Working Hours: 10 hours per day Weekly Off: 1 day per week Additional Benefits: Opportunity for salary increase after 3 months of good performance Experience At least 1 year of experience is preferable Opportunity for training if suitable candidate

রান্নার আগে খাবারের উপকরণ প্রস্তুত করা (কাটা, ধোয়া ইত্যাদি) শেফ ও কিচেন স্টাফদের কাজে সহায়তা করা কিচেন ও কাজের জায়গা পরিষ্কার-পরিচ্ছন্ন রাখা থালা-বাসন ও কিচেন সরঞ্জাম ধোয়া ও গুছিয়ে রাখা খাবার প্রস্তুতের সময় হাইজিন ও ফুড সেফটি মেনে চলা কিচেনের প্রয়োজনীয় জিনিসপত্র সঠিকভাবে সংরক্ষণে সহায়তা করা নির্দেশনা অনুযায়ী নির্ধারিত কাজ সময়মতো সম্পন্ন করা কিচেনে টিম হিসেবে কাজ করা এবং সহযোগিতা বজায় রাখা

Responsibilities: Preparing ingredients for cooking (cutting, washing, etc.) before cooking Assisting chefs and kitchen staff in their work Keeping the kitchen and work area clean and tidy Washing and organizing utensils and kitchen equipment Maintaining hygiene and food safety during food preparation Assisting in proper storage of necessary kitchen items Completing assigned tasks according to instructions and on time Working as a team in the kitchen and maintaining cooperation

Requirements: Interest in learning and sense of responsibility towards work Concept of kitchen hygiene and cleanliness Ability to work for long hours Mentality to follow teamwork and guidance At least 1 year of experience is preferable Opportunity for training if suitable candidate Mentality to work in both shifts Salary and Benefits Monthly Salary: 8,000-10,000 Taka Food Allowance: 2,500 Taka Working Hours: 10 hours per day Weekly Off: 1 day per week Additional Benefits: Opportunity for salary increase after 3 months of good performance Experience At least 1 year of experience is preferable Opportunity for training if suitable candidate
